fine_topics.name: Slavery, Emancipation & Sectionalism
fine_topics.definition: Disputes over slavery in the territories and sectional compromise, and the emancipation, colonization, and new civil status of the freedmen.

fine_topics.name: Reconstruction & Southern Self-Government
fine_topics.definition: Pacification of the former Confederate states, restoration of local self-government, and protection of citizens' rights after the war.

fine_topics.name: Chinese Immigration & Exclusion
fine_topics.definition: The character of Chinese immigration and contract labor, registration and passport proposals, race prejudice, and mob violence against Chinese laborers.

fine_topics.name: Civil Rights, Voting Rights & Discrimination
fine_topics.definition: Federal action to end racial denial of the vote and secure equal rights, combat discrimination, and include the disabled and minorities in American life.

fine_topics.name: Indian Affairs, Removal & Allotment
fine_topics.definition: Relations with Indian tribes: frontier hostilities and treaties, efforts to 'civilize' them, removal beyond the states, reservation policy, and allotment of lands in severalty.

fine_topics.name: Elections & Voting Integrity
fine_topics.definition: Federal supervision of elections and enforcement laws, disputed vote-counting, and modern controversies over voting rights and ballot integrity.
